t0001-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0001-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0001-02.gloss: Plant-colored residue remains on containers near a police post.
t0001-02.rival_reading: Cleanup after a road closure could leave plant matter in ordinary containers; the residue does not identify a program or its source.
